title: LUKS Container in Logical Volume | Some GB Missing
body: I have this logical volume: # lvdisplay --units B -v /dev/vg0/DataContainer --- Logical volume --- LV Path /dev/vg0/DataContainer LV Name DataContainer VG Name vg0 LV UUID hVq7kR-SZcr-tXiE-N7ou-jEY3-KfZe-bHZZrF LV Write Access read/write LV Creation host, time xxx, 2020-01-14 22:45:46 +0100 LV Status available # open 1 LV Size 75161927680 B Current LE 17920 Segments 1 Allocation inherit Read ahead sectors auto - currently set to 256 Block device 253:6 It is mounted like that: /dev/mapper/vg0-DataContainer on /var/lib/dac type ext4 (rw,noatime,data=writeback) Inside the mount there are several LUKS-Containers. It appears to fit inside the LV since it is smaller than the logical volume. du is showing the size of all LUKS containers inside their directory: # du -sb /var/lib/dac/ 71782400000 /var/lib/dac/ One LUKS-Container is this: #cryptsetup status /dev/mapper/DAC-Backup /dev/mapper/DAC-Backup is active and is in use. type: LUKS2 cipher: aes-xts-plain64 keysize: 512 [bits] key location: keyring device: /dev/loop99 loop: /var/lib/dac/DAC-Backup sector size: 512 [bytes] offset: 32768 [512-byte units] (16777216 [bytes]) size: 53967232 [512-byte units] (27631222784 [bytes]) mode: read/write df shows this: # df -a --block-size=M /dev/mapper/vg0-DataContainer 70248M 68458M 0M 100% /var/lib/dac df seems right, because I am running out of space when trying to do a particular backup, which should fit. When I run # resize2fs /dev/mapper/DAC-Backup resize2fs 1.47.4 (6-Mar-2025) File system has 6745904 (4k) blocks already. Nothing to do! I do not understand why it shows a usage of 100% even there should be storage left. Am I doing wrong calculation? Could you shed some light on it? Thanks, - fuz
